newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices ease on rising arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices ease on rising arrivals.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Tuesday fell on increased offerings, dealers said.
Fresh physical buying was lower while fresh arrivals prompted light profit-taking at improved levels. Sugar was up by 10/18 rupees per quintal on Monday.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by five rupees to 1,230/1,275 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved down by eight rupees to 1,270/1,365 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery also moved down by 10 rupees to 1,175/1,178 rupees per quintal.
